_comment: Copy this file to config.json and adjust your local setup.
_comment_docs: Detailed configuration guide and examples: docs/configuration.md and docs/configuration-examples.md

ha._comment: Optional Home Assistant integration. Standalone default keeps HA disabled.

system._comment: Standalone default: HA disabled, live Zendure control enabled. Set dry_run=true for a no-write validation run.

output_control._comment_output_control: Advanced output smoothing/tuning. Most users should keep the defaults.

winter._comment: Optional winter SOC strategy. See docs/configuration-examples.md before changing advanced values.

dashboard._comment: Optional live dashboard. Runtime write mode is unavailable until a local admin password is configured with emsctl dashboard set-password.

influxdb._comment: Optional InfluxDB 2.x history/analytics backend. When disabled, the dashboard keeps using local SQLite history. The bundled docker-compose InfluxDB is the primary supported target. Config is the source of truth: bucket prefix, retention, downsampling tasks and query profiles are reconciled into InfluxDB by 'emsctl.py influx sync'.
influxdb._comment_token: Leave token empty to read it from the env var named by token_env (recommended; do not commit secrets).

energy_savings._comment: Lightweight SQLite daily energy statistics based on measured inverter AC output. Set price_per_kwh to estimate savings.

battery_full_charge_assist._comment: Optional EMS full-charge assist. Temporarily raises device Max-SoC to 100% so battery-backed devices reach firmware Max-SoC at least once within the configured interval.

_comment_devices: One entry per Zendure device. IP and SN must match your local device.

devices.name: WR1
devices._comment_soc: min_soc/max_soc in percent. Use 0 to leave the value unmanaged.

devices.name: WR2
devices._comment_soc: min_soc/max_soc in percent. Use 0 to leave the value unmanaged.

grid_meter._comment: Household/grid power meter. Supported types: shelly, ecotracker, tasmota_http. Shelly uses total power by default. Use channels like [c] or [a,c] to read selected Shelly clamps. Tasmota needs url or ip plus power_path, for example StatusSNS.SML.Power_curr.

shelly._comment: Legacy fallback for one release. Prefer grid_meter above for new configs.
